subject: Dynamic multi-season occupancy modelling with covariates that are year dependent

messages.author: 3547125dc2e38326
messages.subject: Dynamic multi-season occupancy modelling with covariates that are year dependent
parts:
Hello everyone,

I am working on modelling occupancy, colonization, and extinction of one species using data collected over three years using unmarked. The variables I am looking at change between each year. My occupancy model runs, but when trying to analyze colonization/ extinction I run into multiple errors. I've combined the variables from the last two years into one covariate per habitat variable (because doing them separately would not work)  and when I go to run it I get the error message "varying matrix sizes". I understand that is because my null model (top occupancy) has a matrix of 1 and my other models have a matrix of 1:2 since they are for 2 years. How do I address this?

Many thanks

messages.author: 20119867e986c754
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Dynamic multi-season occupancy modelling with covariates that are year dependent
parts:
It's OK, we all have to learn sometime.

I think what you have for the habitat variables is what would be described as YearlySiteCov. I suggest you try to format it like it says in the help description for unmarkedMultFrame(). I think that is where you're problem may lie. Covariates for gamma and epsilon need to be coded as YearlySiteCovs. There should be one for each year.

If you could go to your console and use the command summary(?umf) wher ?umf is the name of your unmarked frame (your data in unmarked) and then copy and paste that into the email, it would help us help you.

Hardin
